title: EduPlan, monde Encarta : choisis la direction
question: La roue a tiré « La Frise de la semaine ». Garde-la, prends une alternative, ou relance.

options.label: La Frise de la semaine
options.lineage: Encarta Interactive Timeline (1997-2009) + Category Browser colours
options.thesis: The school week drawn as Encarta's interactive timeline, every slot coloured by its subject family.
materials: Georgia titles + Verdana UI (Microsoft 1996 core fonts)
options.viewport: Blue rail and search bar; a full-width week frise (Lun-Ven, Primaire/Secondaire lanes, a live 'now' line) owns the top; below, 'À régler' with proof lists, big school numbers, shortcuts.
options.risk: The frise needs real timetable data; with an empty timetable the hero turns into an empty state that must still teach.

raised.raise: Hierarchy by scale contrast alone: school numbers set at display size, labels tiny, no boxes around them.
One thing owns the first viewport: the frise, not a grid of equal cards.
Every count is paired with its proof: '60 h/sem pour 1 enseignante' lists the 10 classes behind it.
Nothing disappears, it cancels: a solved gap is stamped 'Réglé' and stays visible for the week.
Total colour commitment: subject families are flat, unmodulated fields, never gradients or tints.

options.label: L'article de l'école
options.lineage: Encarta article page with its fact box, media pane and 'Voir aussi'
options.thesis: The home is the encyclopedia entry about your own school, with a live fact box.
materials: blue title bar, fact-box table, media pane
options.viewport: Blue title bar 'École Internationale de Dakar'; article sections Structure / Corps enseignant / Emploi du temps with inline links; Fiche infobox on the right; timetable thumbnail as the media pane.
options.risk: The most familiar Encarta reading: reads as a document, so pending actions sit lower than on a task screen.

options.label: Le Lexique
options.lineage: 19th-century lexicon page: guide words, shoulder index, colour plates
options.thesis: The school as a dictionary page: classes are entries, colour lives only in the timetable plate.
options.viewport: Guide words 'CP A — Terminale B' at the head; a column of class entries with apparatus; a bordered colour plate of the week on the right; a shoulder thumb index Primaire/Secondaire.
options.case: Francophone staff know the Larousse by heart, so it holds audience identification; it loses on product clarity for a working screen.
options.risk: Black-on-cream reads as the bookish default and drifts from Encarta's screen colour.

options.label: Specimen typographique
options.thesis: One giant glyph morphed by sliders.
options.viewport: A giant letter and an axis slider.
options.case: No school role identifies with it, and it carries no timetable meaning.
options.risk: Pure type play on a working screen.

options.label: Fil vertical
options.thesis: One item owns the screen, the next one snap away.
options.viewport: One class fills the screen, actions on a right rail.
options.case: Admins compare many classes at once; one-at-a-time paging hides the school.
options.kept: One thing owns the first viewport.

options.label: Monochrome produit
options.thesis: Neutral scale, one accent, claim paired with proof.
options.case: It is the category default and drops the Encarta brief.
options.kept: Every count paired with its proof.

options.label: Pochette de billets
options.thesis: Coupons that tear off and get stamped.
options.viewport: Each class as a coupon in a wallet.
options.case: Travel ephemera is foreign to school staff and families.

options.label: Plan du zoo
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.viewport: The school as a map of coloured lobes.
options.case: Fun for students, but lobes cannot carry a dense week grid for admins.

canonCard.label: Le tableau de bord standard
canonCard.thesis: What school admin dashboards ship, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, four KPI cards, pending actions table, recent activity.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other school SaaS, and Encarta is gone.
